headline: Leipzig Fence Breach Puts Airport Access Under Police Scrutiny
deck: Police are assessing whether a vehicle breached the Leipzig/Halle perimeter near parked Russian Antonov cargo aircraft, closing the north runway and halting northern-side operations.
body: A police spokesman, who was not named, said a car may have broken through the fence into Leipzig/Halle Airport, where the damaged section is near parked Russian Antonov cargo aircraft [E1][E2]. This paper last covered Leipzig/Halle on 3 September; the change is a damaged perimeter fence near the Russian cargo aircraft [E2].
Police closed the north runway and halted flight operations on the airport’s northern side [E3].
The damage was discovered shortly before 23:00, and police said their investigation indicated with high probability that a vehicle had broken through the fence [E4][E5].
